title: worker-result.json
description: Implementation report. Sole writer: developer. Every downstream gate trusts this artifact, so a fabricated green result here is the most damaging failure in the pipeline.

summary.description: What was implemented, in a short paragraph.

steps_completed.description: Step orders from plan.json that are done.

files_changed.description: The exact list. Compared against plan.json affected_files by the scope invariant.

covers.description: The behavior or AC ID this test protects.

tests_run.description: Actually executed commands with their actual results. Never report a command as passing that was not run.

output_summary.description: Real observed output, e.g. "42 passed, 1 failed".

acceptance_addressed.description: Which AC IDs the implementation addresses, and how. QA verifies these claims independently rather than trusting them.

deviations.description: Every departure from the plan, with the reason. A silent deviation is a review blocker.

from.description: The plan step or design element departed from.

unresolved_concerns.description: The honest list. Do not hide a problem because the task technically completed. Empty is only correct when there genuinely are none.

architecture_problems_found.description: Architectural problems discovered while implementing. Reported, not silently fixed — routing back to the tech lead is required by AGENTS.md.

new_work_discovered.description: Out-of-scope work found. Becomes a new task, never an expanded one.

blockers.description: Required non-empty when status is blocked.

needs.description: What would unblock this, and from whom.

environment.description: The confirmed development environment. Required. A build or test failure caused by the WRONG environment is indistinguishable from a code defect, so the environment is confirmed with the human before any verification command runs, and the confirmation is recorded here.

confirmed_by_user.description: Must be true. The validator rejects an implementation report that ran verification without a human-confirmed environment, because an unconfirmed environment converts setup problems into false defect reports and triggers rework cycles that cost more than the confirmation.

runtime.description: Language runtime and version actually used, e.g. 'Node 20.11' or 'Python 3.11 (conda env: vi)'.

environment_manager.description: How the environment was selected, e.g. conda, venv, nvm, container.

services_running.description: Services required by the verification commands, and their state.

config_present.description: Configuration values that had to be present. Never record secret values here — names only.

commands_confirmed.description: The authoritative install / lint / typecheck / test commands the human confirmed.

baseline_state.description: Did the suite pass before the change? Separating pre-existing failures from new ones is essential, otherwise every pre-existing failure gets attributed to this change.

environment_findings.description: Problems with the environment itself — a missing tool, a version mismatch, an unstarted service. These are environment findings, never implementation defects.
